ShortDescription.Value: A compact draggable error logger and searchable live mod-tool shelf.

Publish.LongDescription:
Stacklight turns the game's diagnostic stream into a small, useful status beacon.
The draggable three-color light stays tucked into the interface and opens a clean session log when you need it. Green means clear, amber means low-grade Minor notices are available, and red means errors were reported. The launcher badge counts unique errors rather than every repeated occurrence.
Features: - Works in both normal gameplay and the Editor - Compact draggable launcher with persistent position - Ctrl+Shift+L keyboard toggle - Captures the same warning-and-error stream used by the game - Resets for each loaded map and filters records explicitly tied to other saved maps - Groups repeated messages and shows occurrence counts without inflating the launcher badge - Keeps warning-level records in a quieter Minor notices tier, hidden by default - Compact and expanded panel sizes - A visible custom scrollbar with drag and track-click navigation - Expandable stack traces with one-click Copy - Copy a complete session report for bug reports or mod support - Automatically replaces your Windows profile path with %USERPROFILE% in copied text - Redacts usernames, email addresses, bearer tokens, and common credential fields - Includes the active playset's enabled mod names, versions, and PDX IDs - Adds a searchable tool-first Mods shelf with favorites and inline expansion - Uses native mod thumbnails when available, with compact monogram fallbacks - Shows verified hotkeys and live state for qualified tools - Calls safe quick actions through each owning mod's registered bindings - Hides passive libraries by default while keeping an All enabled-mod view - Disables missing controls instead of guessing or duplicating another mod's state - Lets any mod opt in through a dependency-free tool-manifest binding contract - Recognizes the Map Editor Bridge optional-integration set without taking control of those mods - Owns the shared Mods view when Map Editor Bridge is installed, preventing duplicate drawers - Bounded to the latest 100 unique records to prevent runaway UI growth - Clear log and reset-position controls
Built for: - Players with large mod playsets who need to identify and share a failure - Map and asset creators who want diagnostics close at hand in the Editor - Mod testers reproducing a bug or checking whether one failure keeps repeating - Mod authors checking their own creations and support helpers who need copyable source names and stack traces
Useful when: - A tool stops responding or a UI action silently fails - The built-in error panel flashes by or becomes difficult to read - One repeating error floods the console and you need it grouped into a count - You need to distinguish warnings from actual errors - You are filing a bug report and want a privacy-safe diagnostic block to paste
Stacklight is a diagnostic viewer. It does not alter simulation, saves, assets, or other mods. A reported error may come from the game or any installed mod; Stacklight records the source when the logging system provides one.
Why a working game can still show records: Games and mods commonly log recoverable conditions, fallbacks, optional-content checks, and repeated warnings without stopping the current map. Stacklight records evidence; a record alone does not mean a save is broken. Minor notices remain available for mod testing and deeper diagnosis.
Source code: https://github.com/ximxesabortion/cities2/tree/main/stacklight
Support and discussion: https://forum.paradoxplaza.com/forum/threads/beta-stacklight-support-feedback-and-diagnostic-reports.1936365/
This is an unofficial community mod and is not affiliated with Paradox Interactive or the game developers.
Publish.ChangeLog:
Quieter notices, honest counts, and public source.
- Launcher and summary totals now count unique records instead of every repetition - Warning-level records move into a quieter Minor notices tier hidden by default - Repetition remains visible as xN on each record for diagnosis - Adds guidance for players and mod authors about recoverable diagnostics - Publishes complete source at github.com/ximxesabortion/cities2
